logline: Put on trial for witchcraft and poisoning, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock, refusing to renounce her mother's herbal medicine even after her coerced maid gives false testimony against her.
continuity_notes: Following the aristocratic Lord's ruthless extortion of the young maid in his study, Episode 34 transitions directly into the crowded courtroom trial where the conspirators unleash their manufactured charges and false witnesses against Lady Juliana.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.

segments.label: JUDGE (Booming, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]

segments.label: JUDGE (O.S.) (Inquisitive, Severe)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Do you deny possessing this book?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Calm, Unflinching)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.

segments.label: JUDGE (Stern, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Do you deny using its remedies?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Firm)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.

segments.label: JUDGE (Hard, Pressing)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Proud, Dignified)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I admit to healing the sick.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.

segments.label: JUDGE (Furious, Shouting)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Silence!

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.

segments.label: JUDGE (Commanding)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking up with tears streaming down her pale face.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Trembling, Tearful)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Judge leaning forward with folded hands.

segments.label: JUDGE (Probing, Formal)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile over-the-shoulder shot from behind Prudence toward Lady Juliana standing bound in iron cuffs at the prisoner's dock.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly, Urgent)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Tell the truth.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence breaking down in tears, squeezing her eyes shut as guilt overwhelms her.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Heartbroken)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking at her former maid, a momentary flicker of hurt passing through her eyes before settling into stoic composure.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of the Judge recording notes in the open court ledger with a feather quill.

segments.label: JUDGE (Measured, Stern)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: What did you see?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence clutching both hands to her chest in anguish.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Choked with Tears)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge leaning back slightly, pointing his hand accusingly.

segments.label: JUDGE (Pressing, Sharp)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Did she draw strange markings?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Prudence's tear-streaked face as she hesitates, her breath hitching.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Faltering, Desperate)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched index finger with piercing intensity.

segments.label: JUDGE (Accusatory, Forceful)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Prudence weeping uncontrollably, her face contorted in unbearable remorse.

segments.label: PRUDENCE (Weeping, Shaken)
segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot of the Lord stepping into the open aisle of the courtroom with arms spread wide, turning triumphantly toward the Judge.

segments.label: LORD (Triumphant, Smug)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana gripping the railing, leaning forward.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Indignant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: It was not a ritual!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge repeatedly hammers his gavel down onto the desk, roaring over her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge striking the wooden block twice in rapid succession.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: [Violent, resonant double bang of the wooden gavel]

segments.label: JUDGE (Bellowing)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: You will speak when addressed!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Lord extending his palm toward the gallery with theatrical composure.

segments.label: LORD (Calm, Poisonous)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: We have further witnesses.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of an anxious townsman standing by the gallery pews, nervously wringing his woolen hat in his hands.

segments.label: TOWNSMAN (Nervous, Fearful)
segments.speaker: TOWNSMAN
segments.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Judge glaring down expectantly.

segments.label: JUDGE (Sharp)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: And?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the townsman's face tightening with coached distress.

segments.label: TOWNSMAN (Agitated)
segments.speaker: TOWNSMAN
segments.text: She became violently ill.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot among the spectators as an elderly peasant woman stands up from the wooden bench, pointing an accusatory finger across the courtroom.

segments.label: OLD WOMAN (Shrill, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: OLD WOMAN
segments.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side two-shot of the Lord stepping up to the dock, looming beside Lady Juliana as she looks him in the eye.

segments.label: LORD (Mocking, Smug)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: She calls it healing.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Lord turns dramatically to face the entire assembly, gesturing toward the spectators.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Lord addressing the courtroom.

segments.label: LORD (Resonant, Vindicative)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: The people call it poisoning!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking past him directly toward the gallery with sharp clarity.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Incisive, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: What were their illnesses?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of the Lord looking down arrogantly over his shoulder.

segments.label: LORD (Dismissive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Irrelevant.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana gritting her teeth in fierce defiance.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Fierce)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: It is not irrelevant!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Lady Juliana standing tall against the courtroom window light, her chained hands resting on the balustrade as she addresses the entire hall.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Clear, Unyielding)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge sitting with steepled fingers upon his high bench.

segments.label: JUDGE (Coldly Inquisitive)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: You admit you administered them?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking straight forward.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Direct)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Yes.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge gesturing with an open hand.

segments.label: JUDGE (Challenging)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Without the approval of a licensed physician?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana shaking her head slightly, truth ringing in her voice.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Earnest)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: There was no physician willing to help them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana's steady gaze.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Calm, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: So I helped them.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

segments.label: LORD (Derisive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

segments.label: JUDGE (Grave, Stern)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Unyielding)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

segments.label: JUDGE (Ominous, Warning)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Think carefully.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I have.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

segments.label: JUDGE (Severe, Imposing)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Then let it be.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]

segments.label: JUDGE (Thunderous)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Enough!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.

segments.label: JUDGE (Booming, Solemn)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.

segments.text: So I helped them.

segments.text: Medium close-up of the Lord smiling cynically as he turns back toward the magistrate.

segments.label: LORD (Derisive)
segments.speaker: LORD
segments.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge holding his hand over the open law book.

segments.label: JUDGE (Grave, Stern)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Unyielding)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: No.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

segments.label: JUDGE (Ominous, Warning)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Think carefully.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Firm, Resolute)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: I have.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

segments.label: JUDGE (Severe, Imposing)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Proud, Fearless)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Then let it be.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Prudence buries her face in her stained white apron, shuddering with grief.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot pushing into Lady Juliana's face as she speaks directly across the hall with compassionate, unwavering authority.

segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Passionate, Defiant)
segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
segments.text: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up profile of the Lord, his smirk instantly freezing into an irritated, malevolent scowl.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge furiously smashes his gavel down upon the sound block with a deafening crack.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the Judge slamming the wooden gavel down.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: [Violent, resonant smash of the wooden gavel]

segments.label: JUDGE (Thunderous)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Enough!

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge rises to his full height behind the bench, towering over the silent court.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot looking up at the imposing Judge as he stands formally to deliver the judgment.

segments.label: JUDGE (Booming, Solemn)
segments.speaker: JUDGE
segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lady Juliana in the prisoner's dock looking toward the Judge, who solemnly raises his right hand to pronounce the final sentence as the heavy silence hangs over the courtroom.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The Judge extends his raised hand high in judgment over Lady Juliana as the scene holds on her standing still and unbroken before fading to black.
